sara_support: FYI customer reporting recurring 502s hitting /v1/complete in prod. They gave a request_id: req_7f4a2c9b. Can infra search server-side logs for that ID?

alex_infra: Got it, will check. Do we have the exact timestamp from the customer?

sara_support: Customer says ~2024-05-02T16:22:10Z (approx). They also pasted a curl they ran, added below.

customer_jd: here is the curl i used — it fails consistently for me:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/complete 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"rwd-large-1","input":"summarize this..."}' -v```

alex_infra: Thanks. Searching logs indices now. Note: edge request logs are only kept for 14d; core service logs are 90d. If the event is older than 14d and only exists at edge, we may not find it.

mitch_sre: quick heads up — if the customer is calling through our CDN, request_id may be in the `edge.request_id` field instead of `request_id`. I'll try both.

alex_infra: Kibana query I'm running (KQL):```(request_id: "req_7f4a2c9b" OR edge.request_id: "req_7f4a2c9b") AND http.status_code: 502```

logbot: matched 1 document in logs-prod-requests-* index for request_id=req_7f4a2c9b. snippet:```2024-05-02T16:22:11.123Z service=completion-core level=error msg="handler: write failed" request_id=req_7f4a2c9b trace_id=tr_55a2f user_id=acct_987 status=502 backend_error="upstream timeout"```

alex_infra: Looks like core returned an upstream timeout. I'll pull the correlated traces (trace_id tr_55a2f) and see which upstream timed out.

jordan_pm: Customer also mentioned sudden spike in latency earlier this week — could be related. If upstream was a model shard, we should check model node health around that time.

mitch_sre: Steps to reproduce for logs + debug bundle: 1) Ask customer to re-run their curl with an added header `X-Debug-Mode: true` and include `X-Request-ID` if the client supports it. 2) If it happens again, have them capture the server-provided `request_id` from response headers. 3) We can generate a debug bundle on our side with `support-debug-bundle --request-id req_7f4a2c9b --include-trace` and attach it to the ticket.

alex_infra: I ran the trace and saw the completion-core called model-infer-03 and got a socket timeout at 16:22:10. Model node logs show heavy GC around that minute. Possible noisy neighbor.

sara_support: Great, please prepare a short summary for the customer explaining root cause and next steps. Also confirm whether we can restore logs beyond retention — customer asked for full request payload but we only keep payloads in core for 90d.

mitch_sre: We cannot restore edge logs past 14d. For this specific request we have the core log and the trace. I'll produce the debug bundle and attach sanitized payload. Recommend we redact API keys before sharing. :white_check_mark:

alex_infra: Creating the bundle now — ETA ~10m. Command I used to search raw ES via curl (for internal use):```curl -s -u es-readonly:REDACTED "https://es.prod.internal/logs-*/_search?q=request_id: \"req_7f4a2c9b\"&size=50" | jq .hits.hits[]._source```

customer_jd: thank you. appreciate the quick follow up — let me know when you have the bundle.

logbot: debug-bundle ready: sb-20240502-req_7f4a2c9b.tar.gz (sanitized). Attaching to ticket 4321.

sara_support: closing loop with customer now, will include a brief RCA and suggested mitigations (retry/backoff and we will add more model-node capacity). :thumbsup:
